diagnosis: The customer is on legacy_auth and needs to reset their API token. The request is a standard how-to covered by existing documentation, so no escalation is required per policy.
reply:
Hello,

To reset your API token, please open the Security tab in your account settings and choose "Reset token." Please note that your previous API token will remain valid for 24 hours after the reset to allow for a smooth transition.

This process applies specifically to accounts currently using Legacy Auth. If you have any further questions, feel free to ask.

Best regards,
Support Team
